title: Ballot contest research
description: Researches one contest on the user's imported ballot: verified candidates, their official websites, voting instructions, and the office's top responsibilities.

variables.name: electionName
variables.description: Election display text (e.g. `2026 Maryland Primary Election`).

variables.name: contestTitle
variables.description: Contest title without the `Contest:` prefix or type markers.

variables.name: contestCandidates
variables.description: Candidate names already imported under this contest. When present, the AI is told to use them instead of searching.

surfaces: My Vision → Ballot Research → Contest → Options (`ballot_contest_research`)

usage.notes: Indentation of the verified-candidate list is normalized to three spaces for every name.
